comments.author: Blackwidow
comments.body: Desire check, wanna see how many people would wanna see mass production of these and a reasonable price to pay for em.

comments.author: Jean
comments.body: I doubt you'll see much high demand - maritime players don't often shoot from the rear. Trade/Adv players might use it while trying to escape a pirate, but personally it wouldn't be worth the inventory space for me. You might have more luck mass-producing Bow Carronades.

comments.author: Blackwidow
comments.body: how much for the bow ones then?

comments.author: Cornelia
comments.body: I often see them (both bow and stern) around 500k each in bazaars, higher in company shops.

comments.author: Lena
comments.body: They last forever for traders, since you don't use it very often. I find it's simpler to just carry tributes though.

comments.author: Jean
comments.body: Exactly, Lena. And as Cornelia said, 500K for bow & stern carronades is very common. If you really wanted them to move and still make decent profit (they're dirt cheap to make, really) you could put 'em for 200-300K.
